summary: The Event Streaming Engineer designs and implements event-driven systems that process, store, and distribute real-time events across multiple systems and applications.
responsibilities: Develop event-driven architectures using Kafka, Pulsar, or similar systems
Build event pipelines for real-time processing and analytics
Ensure event consistency, ordering, and delivery guarantees
Collaborate with software engineering and data teams
Optimize event processing performance and scalability

education: 3–6 years of experience in event-driven engineering

skills_required.name: Expertise in Kafka, Pulsar, or similar messaging systems
Programming in Java, Scala, or Python
Knowledge of stream processing frameworks like Flink or Spark Streaming
Strong understanding of distributed system principles
